description: Aggregate values for any Klaviyo metric (e.g. opens, clicks, revenue) over a custom timeframe + interval. More flexible than campaign/flow reports - use for any metric.

end.description: Custom end YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to now.

interval.description: Note: metric-aggregates uses singular (hour/day/week/month), NOT the series-report plural form.

measurement.description: count, sum_value (revenue), or unique. Default count.

start.description: Custom start YYYY-MM-DD. Raw events have NO 2023 floor - reaches back to account inception. Max 1 year per call.

timeframe.description: Preset lookback. Use this OR start/end. Default: last_30_days.

name: metric_aggregate
